community_list_entries.name: FlashAdventure — Long-Term Memory for GUI Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: FlashAdventure (arXiv 2509.01052) is a benchmark of 34 Flash adventure games for GUI agents. It targets the 'observation-behavior gap', the challenge of remembering and acting on earlier gameplay information within a full story arc. Memory is a stated design target. It does not test cross-task reuse
